purpose: Qualify the smallest real-soil composition in which a dry prescribed-flux top boundary is accepted only while physically admissible and an inadmissible dry-flux trial is rolled back and recomputed from the same committed soil/surface state under a finite positive ponding-head boundary. Also qualify already-ponded continuation. This gate deliberately stops before top-node h=0 crossing and before physical pond-depletion back-switch qualification.

boundary_complementarity_contract.dry_flux_trial: Solve the real three-cell finite-volume soil trial with q_top=q_supply and S=0. After the solve, evaluate the qualified h_surface=0 surface-face capacity against the solved top-node head. The dry trial is admissible only if the imposed supply does not exceed that capacity within roundoff and the top node remains inside the qualified negative-head scope.
boundary_complementarity_contract.inadmissible_flux_trial: Must not publish any soil head, surface state, time, cumulative ledger or diagnostic total. The ponded/head solve starts again from the exact same committed state.
boundary_complementarity_contract.ponded_head_trial: Solve soil heads and S1 simultaneously. Set h_surface=S1 and q_top from the qualified 5 cm surface-face relation. Enforce S1-S0 = dt*(q_supply-q_top) together with all three soil finite-volume balances.
boundary_complementarity_contract.already_ponded: If S0>0, enter the ponded/head solve directly; do not run a dry prescribed-flux predictor merely as a numerical convenience.
boundary_complementarity_contract.stale_flux_rule: No q_top calculated under the rejected dry-flux branch may be reused as the physical top flux of the accepted ponded branch.
boundary_complementarity_contract.top_node_saturation_rule: Any trial with h_top_node > -1e-8 cm fails closed in E3G. Qualification of h_top_node=0 or positive belongs to a later explicit gate.
boundary_complementarity_contract.depletion_rule: If a ponded trial would deplete S below zero, E3G fails closed and reports a later event-localized back-switch gate as required. No clipping to S=0 and no stale ponded q_top continuation is allowed.

candidate_and_reference.candidate_surface_face: E3E-R2R3 bounded remediated 5 cm surface face including analytic saturated segment and certified physical-envelope snap where qualified
candidate_and_reference.reference_surface_face: E3E-R2R3 endpoint-aware high-accuracy reference; positive h_surface uses exact-physical-upper high-precision oracle
candidate_and_reference.candidate_internal_faces: existing qualified C1R and E2C-R3 routes only; any UNQUALIFIED_FACE_FALLBACK is a gate failure
candidate_and_reference.reference_internal_faces: full-accuracy steady Darcy reference already used in E3 qualification
candidate_and_reference.qualification_solver: bounded scipy least_squares harness; qualification-only, not production implementation

architecture_checks.2_kernel_io_separation: composition API is calculation-only; no file/path/parser semantics
architecture_checks.3_explicit_data_separation: soil committed state, surface committed state, forcing, face result, trial scratch and result ledger are distinct
architecture_checks.4_compact_persistent_state: surface adds one scalar only when surface storage physics is active; Ross mixed variables remain worker-local
architecture_checks.5_scratch_per_worker: nonlinear vectors, face costs and rejected predictors are trial/worker scratch
architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: inadmissible flux predictors and failed ponded solves may not mutate committed state
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: dt is generic and independent of day boundaries
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: soil plus surface plus bottom exchange must close without repair
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: surface process consumes a soil-face contract; this qualification instantiates RossFast but does not make the process Ross-specific
architecture_checks.21_reuse_swap_physics: functional flux/head complementarity and ponding semantics are reused without legacy globals
architecture_checks.22_no_headcalc_internals: surface composition sees face flux/capacity results, not internal solver arrays
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: ponding is a physical state/mode; least-squares/retry policy is numerical
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: at most one rejected dry predictor plus one accepted ponded solve in the switch scenario
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: full-accuracy reference remains separate from bounded candidate
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: mode, rejected predictor, face route, solve cost and mass residuals are explicit
architecture_checks.27_optional_functionality_scales: surface storage scalar is absent when this physical component is inactive
architecture_checks.29_no_silent_dependencies: 5 cm geometry, head interval and dt are explicit
architecture_checks.30_change_explicitly_checked: this precommit freezes claims and thresholds before execution

hard_nonclaims: No top soil-node h=0 or positive-head qualification.
No physical pond-depletion head-to-flux back-switch qualification.
No runoff with real soil state; runoff remains qualified only at the E3F ledger seam.
No evaporation, interception, snow, runon or irrigation decomposition.
No response tangent across top-boundary mode or endpoint/snap switching.
No production implementation, runtime, MultiSWAP, MODFLOW or groundwater admission.
